title: two pages of one run are one household under a head not held
line: the 1925 New York pages of Mary Peters (Wife, line 23) and Ruth Peters (Daughter, line 25), page 19 of assembly district 01 and election district 06, Nassau, are one household under a head not held, line 24 missing: the form opens a household only at a head's line, nothing held opens one between them and the line between not held is crossed by their one surname; Ruth's page alone is a household of one missing its head, superseded once Mary's is read; Ruth's plan holds the search of FamilySearch's New York 1925 collection for Peters at Hempstead, Nassau, in 1925 with no given name, which the fetch list prints as a lead, until the owner rejects her card
